critical_code_review_comments: IMPORTANT deployment note: /app/frontend uses CRA webpack-dev-server which caches HtmlWebpackPlugin output in-memory. Edits to public/index.html DO NOT hot-reload — a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required for the new <link rel=preload> tags to appear in the served HTML. This was performed during this test run. For future edits to public/index.html the main agent must remember to restart frontend, and production build (`yarn build`) will bake the preloads in correctly.
index.css still has duplicate overflow-x rules (previously noted in i15) — html/body get overflow-x:hidden then html:overflow-x:clip then body:overflow-x:hidden again. Consolidate.
sitemap.xml remains hand-maintained; drift risk persists. Consider generating from data.js at build time.
